notes: Apple software licensing forbids redistribution of Xcode; this module carries locators only. The locator chain is xcode-select -p, then DEVELOPER_DIR, then xcodebuild on PATH; Command-Line-Tools-only hosts are reported as degraded with install guidance.

locators.description: Xcode (App Store). Signing, dotnet publish -r ios-arm64 and xcrun devicectl require macOS + Xcode.
